So far every Beat 'em up I played recently is such an abysmal dogvomit. This one's perfect example.
Well, just looking at how much of it is there makes this statement more of a compliment rather than an insult I guess.

Enemy behavior is mad lazy simple, and that doesn't make it fun to fight against. 
On easy difficulty all of them acting like literal punching bags, when on hardest it levers to another edge, they instantly attack you in the first frame singular pixel of your hurtbox gets inside their hitbox without giving players any sort of workarounds for combos. This creates META in a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ SINGPLEPLAYER / CO-OP GAME!
To effectively play on hardest difficulties, you have to forget about having fun (why then do we even create and play games at this point?) and simply abuse dash + punch attacks, which launches enemies away while also giving you i-frames. It wouldn't be bad at all if there was WALLS to wall splat enemies from so you can chain this dash+punch into actual combos.
Even if you're doing jus that, you still going to fail 50% of the time because how absolutely ♥♥♥♥♥♥ up hurtboxes here are. It's so ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ funny to see AI understanding that and taking advantage of it. They're going to walk at you in certain direction they will be able to hit you while you cannot xD

Imagine yourself running in long ass straight hallway and game just suddenly locks you few times in the middle of and everytime you perform most of attacks (especially dash+punch spam on high diff) all enemies just fly off of screen and you have to wait for them to come back. Yeah, that's exactly what constantly happening in this game. Half of it is launching enemies away with META attacks, and other half is just you waiting for them to come back. Very fun.

There's more smaller annoying things, like throwables that are blending with environment like poison syringes you can't ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ see coming unless you fully lock on them, forgetting about everything else, not even trying to fight with one attack spam, just to be able to dodge them. Oh yeah, forgot to mention - They also have submarine sized hitbox so you can go ♥♥♥♥ yourself. Devs prolly had a lot of fun catching nearly invisible in some places throwables with their faces (if they even played their own game, lol.)

Absence of any sort of direct defense mechanics only makes gameplay more miserable, since all attacks stagger, both yours and foes. So getting instantly hit by stepping with singular pixel inside their hitbox stunlocks you... but hey, at least they're not spamming it for eternity. Another reason stacks on top why you have to spam dash+punch ONLY.

Se você acha que já viu violência em beat ‘em up… Mother Russia Bleeds te mostra que dá pra ir bem mais longe — e mais perturbador.

Mother Russia Bleeds não é só pancadaria — é um soco sujo, cruel e sem filtro.

Inspirado nos clássicos tipo Streets of Rage, ele pega a base do gênero e injeta uma identidade própria: mais pesado, mais grotesco e muito mais agressivo.

O combate é visceral. Cada golpe parece doer, cada finalização é exagerada e o uso da droga “Nekro” adiciona uma mecânica única — você pode curar, buffar ou entrar em um estado ainda mais brutal… mas sempre com aquele risco e sensação de descontrole.

E isso define o jogo.

Aqui não tem glamour. Não tem herói.
Só sobrevivência, vício e violência.

O coop é onde ele realmente brilha. Jogar com amigos transforma tudo em caos organizado — combos improvisados, decisões rápidas e aquele sentimento clássico de “limpar a tela na marra”.

Mas não dá pra ignorar:

Ele pode ser repetitivo.
E o excesso de brutalidade pode cansar — ou até afastar.

Além disso, o jogo não tem a mesma profundidade de progressão que outros beat ‘em ups modernos, o que pode fazer ele perder força depois de algumas horas.

Só que mesmo assim…

Ele marca.

Porque poucos jogos têm coragem de ir tão longe no estilo e na proposta.

Veredito: brutal, estiloso e sem limites. Não é pra todo mundo — mas quem entra, não esquece.

🩸 Nota: 8.5/10
👊 Recomendado para: fãs de beat ‘em up hardcore e coop caótico
⚠️ Aviso: pesado — em todos os sentidos

Genuinely a wonderful game, it has beautiful OST, great fun alone or with a friend, and a good message both about the addictiveness of drugs and the importance of standing up for what's right.
However, if you intend on playing it for achievements, trying to master it, or for any extended period of time, you will come to notice its flaws in how the levels are designed, which is that they are miserable. There are multiple sections where if you make a mistake, it's genuinely worth restarting as the amount you are punished is insane. 
This is not a competent beat 'em up, and should not be treated as such. Combos are nonexistent, with the only one being a knee if you follow up a punch with a kick. Attempting to mix it up also isn't worth it, as knees don't even break blocks. Kick instantly knocks enemies down, the same as 4 other moves. Grabs are simplistic yet satisfying, but ground grabs leave a lot to be desired.
The enemies are okay for the most part, but some of them are plain miserable and poorly designed. Multiple of them have instant ranged attacks, others do them full screen. Many enemies have a dash attack that is very hard to punish, and 90% of the counterplay is just sidestepping. Even the game's implemented feature of an air grab is completely not worth it, as the detection on it and fact you have to delay your inputs to get it to function means you'll get beat out most of the time. This is not helped by the fact the AI is fairly bad at times, with many of them stopping everything to watch you pummel a guy to death. 
The health system is interesting, although very punishing. Having to collect health from enemies you took your time to kill instead of immediately destroying creates a fun dynamic of risk vs reward in larger groups. Overall, enjoyable.
Finally, the bosses. All of them are forgettable. Many of them boil down to "do a special attack or do a special attack and whale on them". The only one of note is the final boss, but that one ends up being so miserable to complete due to the requirements of the "true ending", which causes it to be memorable for pain rather than enjoyment. 
Overall, a great game on many fronts, especially tone, message, and style, but playing for anything longer than a single basic playthrough will make you frustrated beyond belief and rather play something with more substance and polish to its gameplay.

Full of over-the-top stuff, blood everywhere, and vulgarities galore. The interactivity with the scene is really solid. Enemies accidentally shoot each other. There are stages where they actually replicate weird physics situations (like being on top of a moving train and getting moderately dragged backward every time you jump). There's a good variety of weapons you can use against enemies, and they're all interesting. The art is great and always sets up cool backgrounds.

That's it. An ugly and drunk girlfriend. Sometimes kinda annoying, but with a really interesting and unique personality.

Mother Russia Bleeds es un muy bonito beat 'em up clásico decorado de violencia y sangre de una dirección de arte hermosa. Hay una gran variedad de enemigos: drogadictos, policías y militares 
marionetas del poder, fusileras, matones, skinheads, patovicas, mutantes, maníacos, aficionados al BDSM hardcore, perros, cerdos, y [spoiler] hasta un oso hasta el cuello de drogas o algo peor [/spoiler]. 

Vamos a atravesar múltiples escenarios que varían entre trenes, laboratorios, prisión, basureros, discotecas, alcantarillas, las calles de la capital y otro puñado de locaciones más. Cada sitio tiene sus detalles, suceden cosas a nuestras espaldas lo que ayuda a retratar un mundo agonizante pero vivo y dinámico. El pixel art en este jugo tiene mucho cuidado, enseña la identidad y los valores de la realidad alternativa que nos envuelve. 

Las mecánicas de combate si bien son iguales para todos los personajes, o al menos a mí me ha parecido así, hay numerosas armas dispersas por cada nivel. Las armas de fuego son sumamente eficaces según la distancia a la que hagamos nuestro tiro y el fuego amigo entre los enemigos resulta muy útil. Se pueden devolver granadas y gases lacrimógenos, gradas cegadoras, etc.. Los jefes de cada nivel tienen un añadido de defensa y daño lo que implica un abordaje distinto a los enemigos normales, el último [spoiler] que nos topamos tiene incluso un puñado de fases y no es nada fácil [/spoiler]. Para curarnos solo nos agachamos cerca de enemigos convulsionando y les extraemos con una jeringa un poco de droga Nekro para después inyectárnosla... escribirlo se siente algo turbio; pero así es como te curas en el juego. 💉

El argumento en estos juegos no suele ser más que una excusa, en el caso de Mother Russia Bleeds esto no es diferente. Se trata de una distopia ahogada de corrupción, abusos de poder, ultra violencia y droga de la que se te queda en el cuerpo por un buen rato y todo se soluciona a las piñas, a las puñaladas, a los batazos y disparos.

Un aspecto que me resultó divertido son las burlas de cada uno de los personajes, son buenísimas como asquerosas. 

Me resulta algo "curioso" las reseñas negativas de este juego señalando que esperaban mucho más de un juego comercializado por Devolver, que los hit boxes son imprecisos, que no tiene botón de bloquear y que la historia no es buena... A ver, es cierto que tiene ciertas partes jodidas y que no es el eslabón sobresaliente del género, pero tiene personalidad y sabe diferenciarse del resto. Este beat 'em up no va a conmoverlos ni les va a cambiar la vida; pero tiene mucha mala leche y el gore en este formato es muy divertido; es desestresante y satisfactorio. 🤷‍♀️ 

Además es un juego súper barato, si tienen dudas lo compran en rebaja y listo. Mother Russia Bleeds esta Ok.
